newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria to ease ban on foreigners owning land.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria to ease ban on foreigners owning land.

text.p: Bulgaria's cabinet approved on Thursday a draft bill allowing joint ventures with less than 50 percent foreign equity to buy arable land in the country, Agriculture Minister Ventsislav Varbanov said.
"The new bill will lift restrictions on Bulgaria-registered joint ventures with foreign equity below 50 percent to acquire ownership of agricultural land," Varbanov told reporters.
The draft is to be submitted to parliament for approval after the one-month summer recess which begins on Friday.
Prime Minister Ivan Kostov urged parliament earlier this month to remove a constitutional ban on land ownership in Bulgaria by foreign citizens.

Under the country's post-communist constitution passed in 1991, foreign citizens are not allowed to buy land in Bulgaria. Kostov said the restriction reflected Socialist-era views and the European Union had pressed for the law to be changed.
